stories.title: Jefferson County plans magnet school expansion that may halt plans for Irondale school system
stories.summary: Jefferson County Schools Superintendent Dr. Walter Gonsoulin announced plans Monday to expand magnet schools within the district, a move that keeps all three public schools in the city of Irondale under county control.
